note: Static point-in-time snapshot used ONLY when pod-1D-attribute-research has no output for the requested practice area + market. Always flag a run that uses this file with '> INFERRED: attribute set from static fallback pulled 2026-08-14, not a live pull'. Answer engines move; a fallback run is never Confirmed.
method: Live pulls from Google AI Overview (AI Mode) and ChatGPT on 2026-08-14, across two practice areas and two markets, on the query family 'what to look for when hiring a {practice} lawyer in {city}'. Ranked by how consistently each attribute appeared across sources.
counterintuitive_findings: Reviews and awards ranked LOWER than the industry assumes. ChatGPT explicitly states that verifiable bar standing and disciplinary history is more meaningful than ratings alone.

Naming what would make a case difficult scored as a POSITIVE trust signal, while guaranteeing a number is flagged as a RED FLAG. This inverts what an attorney's instinct will be on the day, which is why it belongs in the document rather than in someone's head.

attributes.name: Trial willingness
attributes.consistency: 4 of 4 sources, usually the first sentence of the answer
attributes.detail: Have you taken these to trial, or do you only settle? Google asks it in those words. If you are a trial firm, say so early and say it plainly.
attributes.segment_2_question: Have you taken {practice_area} cases to trial, or do you settle them?

attributes.name: Specific case-type experience
attributes.detail: Not the practice area, the case type. How many of THIS kind, not how many injury cases. How recently.
attributes.segment_2_question: Do you have attorneys who focus specifically on {practice_area} cases?

attributes.name: Fee and expenses in detail
attributes.detail: Percentage, whether it rises if you file suit, who pays records, filing fees, investigators, experts and court reporters, and what happens if you lose.
attributes.segment_2_question: How much does it cost to hire a {practice_area} attorney?

attributes.name: Local court familiarity
attributes.detail: The county court, the judges, how the local defense firms operate. Specifics, not 'we serve the area'.
attributes.segment_2_question: Do you handle {practice_area} cases across {region}, or only in {city}?

attributes.name: Evidence preservation speed
attributes.detail: What you secure in the first days and how fast, before it is deleted or overwritten.
attributes.segment_2_question: What do you do in the first week that a person cannot do on their own?

attributes.name: Expert network
attributes.detail: Name the roles you bring in - reconstructionists, safety engineers, code inspectors, medical specialists, economists.
attributes.segment_2_question: What experts do you bring into a {practice_area} case?

attributes.name: Who actually handles the case day to day
attributes.detail: Am I hiring you, or an intake operation that refers this out? Who do I talk to day to day and how often.
attributes.segment_2_question: Who will actually handle my case day to day?

attributes.name: Honest assessment
attributes.detail: Name what would make the case difficult. Guaranteeing a number is flagged as a red flag by the answer engines. Saying the hard part builds more trust than a promise.
attributes.segment_2_question: What would make my case difficult?

attributes.name: Verifiable bar standing
attributes.detail: Bar license and disciplinary history. ChatGPT says explicitly that this is more meaningful than ratings alone.
attributes.segment_2_question: How can someone check that a lawyer is in good standing?

attributes.name: Deadlines
attributes.detail: Say the number of years and what happens if it passes.
attributes.segment_2_question: How long do you have to file a {practice_area} claim in {state}?
